slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether an aircraft can carry only one bomb per trip or about per-trip carrying capacity; its fuel question assumed a single bomb load but did not confirm the constraint.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to minimize total fuel consumed ... or is it to maximize the probability that at least two key parts are destroyed ...?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and whether it is maximizing the probability of destroying at least two key parts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each aircraft/sortie carries only one bomb, so fuel is computed as one loaded outbound leg plus one empty return leg per bomb.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or received confirmation of the one-bomb-per-trip constraint; it inferred this from the fuel-efficiency setup.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and the P1 one-bomb-per-trip constraint remained unresolved.

summary: The agent resolved the core objective and several fuel/limit details, but it never asked about the one-bomb-per-trip constraint and then became stuck repeatedly asking unresolved probability-combination questions without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
